hooks.command: CMD=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git[[:space:]]+add' && echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'kb/[^ ]*\.md'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"BLOCKED: Staging kb/*.md is forbidden. KB docs are owned by the content team pipeline only."}}'; exit 0; fi
